# Common Loon — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is the scientific name of the Common Loon?", "Gavia immer"),
    ("What does the Common Loon eat?", "fish"),
    ("What is scientific name?", "Gavia immer"),
    ("What is size?", "75 cm"),
    ("What is habitat?", "northern lakes"),
    ("What is diet?", "fish"),
    ("What is range?", "N. America"),
    ("What is notable?", "Yodeling voice of the north woods"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
